note: Proficiency levels are self-assessed and reflect the kind of work represented in this demo portfolio. They are not formal certifications.

groups.title: Frontend engineering
groups.description: Semantic, responsive interfaces with a strong emphasis on accessibility and maintainable component structure.

groups.title: Backend & APIs
groups.description: Product-focused server work: predictable APIs, sensible data boundaries, and code that is easy to operate.

groups.title: Data & storage
groups.description: Relational modeling, query tuning, and choosing storage that fits the access pattern rather than the trend.

groups.title: Cloud & delivery
groups.description: Practical deployment, observability, and automation for small product teams without overbuilding infrastructure.

groups.title: Design & UX
groups.description: Interface design grounded in content, interaction states, and the realities of implementation.

groups.title: Quality & performance
groups.description: Testing, measurement, and performance work treated as part of the feature rather than a final cleanup pass.

principles.title: Choose boring foundations
principles.text: Semantic HTML, a clear data model, and a small dependency surface make everything else easier.

principles.title: Measure before optimizing
principles.text: Performance and accessibility work starts with evidence, not a checklist of fashionable techniques.

principles.title: Design the states
principles.text: Empty, loading, error, and success states are part of the interface, not an afterthought.

principles.title: Leave a trail
principles.text: Good names, short documentation, and honest tests help the next person move faster.
